answer: A farm with a hundred phones can fake presence, but it cannot be in two places at once. Each epoch a beacon publishes a quill-signed challenge; each key must answer in five minutes from its device, bound by fingerprint to a 200-POA bond, while three peers stake 50 POA each to check the echo of the answer. A second key from one wallet pays 800 POA, the tenth 20,000, the hundredth 2,000,000 — cost grows with the square of the key count, so a hundred fakes cost 2,000,000 POA, far above one epoch's reward. Missed windows freeze the bond; three strikes slash it; the umber log keeps only hashes.
